ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: harvest push
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Four days of harder work in the fields. Sowing and harvesting are 30% faster and harvests yield 5% more. Those with a passion for growing like it; most others dislike it, and the lazy and undergrounders hate it.

effects.li: Sowing and harvesting are 30% faster, and harvests yield 5% more.
Those with a passion for growing like it; most others dislike it, and the lazy and undergrounders hate it.

plain.li: If we don't get the harvest in this week, we'll be eating bark by midwinter.

cheerful.li: Dirt under my fingernails all week. My favorite kind of week!

cold.li: Yield per day up nearly a third. Correct priority.

plain.li: I'll be pulling weeds in my dreams.

blunt.li: My back's done. Find someone younger.

gloomy.li: Bent double for days, and the blight will come anyway.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: building season
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Five days of harder work on building and mining. Construction is 30% faster and mining 20% faster. Those with a passion for building or mining and the industrious like it; most others dislike it, and the lazy hate it.

effects.li: Construction is 30% faster and mining 20% faster.
Builders, miners and the industrious like it; most others dislike it, and the lazy hate it.

plain.li: Give me a week and you won't recognize the place.

cheerful.li: A whole new wing! Someone hand me a hammer.

cold.li: Two finished rooms are worth more than five half-built ones.

plain.li: Rock dust in my teeth, rock dust in my bed.

warm.li: I'll help. I just wish someone would build a bath first.

blunt.li: I've laid enough stone this year.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: best behavior
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Everyone is on their best behavior with traders, prisoners and visitors. Negotiation and social impact are 25% higher, so trading, recruiting and dealing with other peoples go better, and trade prices are 3% better. The kind and the sociable like it; the abrasive hate it.

effects.li: Negotiation ability and social impact up 25%: better trading, recruiting and diplomacy.
Trade prices 3% better.
The kind and the sociable like it; the abrasive hate it.

plain.li: Be polite to the traders. We need better prices than we got last time.

warm.li: We've been short with each other for weeks. A few days of kindness would do us good.

cold.li: Courtesy is a negotiating tool. Use it.

blunt.li: If I have to say "please" one more time, I'll bite someone.

plain.li: My face is going to ache from all the smiling.

gloomy.li: Smiling at strangers all day. I'll be worn out by noon.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: days of mourning
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Two days in which all work is 30% slower so the colony can grieve together. Grief wears off much faster, and everyone is less likely to have a mental break. Only possible while someone is grieving.
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.heartCost: everyone works 30% slower for two days

effects.li: Everyone works 30% slower.
Memories of grief wear off much faster (each day ages them by an extra quarter of their length), and mental breaks are less likely.
Most colonists like it and the grieving love it; psychopaths and the industrious dislike it.

plain.li: We owe them this much. A few days of quiet.

warm.li: Come sit with me. Tell me something about them.

gloomy.li: We should do this more. We lose people often enough.

cold.li: Two days of lost work won't bring anyone back.

plain.li: I grieve better with a shovel in my hand.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: on guard
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Everyone stays alert and keeps a weapon close for four days. Shooting and melee are a little more accurate, and everyone tires 15% faster. The bloodthirsty like it; the nervous, the volatile and wimps hate it.

effects.li: Shooting accuracy up 2% and melee hit chance up 6%.
Everyone tires 15% faster.
The bloodthirsty like it and the tough don't mind; the nervous, the volatile and wimps hate it.

plain.li: Let them come. We'll see them first.

blunt.li: Finally. I've been sleeping with a knife anyway.

cold.li: A raid we see coming costs us less.

plain.li: Every snapped twig sounds like a raid now.

gloomy.li: Sitting up all night waiting for raiders. I don't sleep much anyway.

warm.li: Can we at least take turns being scared?

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: clean sweep
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Three days of cleaning the whole home. Everyone who can clean puts it before their other work, even those not set to clean. Fires, the sick and wounded, children, prisoners and cooking still come first, and so do sleep, meals and washing (this needs "Deeper game hooks" on). With a cleaning area mod, the sweep keeps to its area. Cleaning is 50% faster, wounds are tended a little better and immunity builds faster. Most colonists dislike it, but doctors and anyone still healing from a wound or an illness like it, and ask for it when many are hurt.

effects.li: Everyone who can clean does it before other work, after fires, the sick, children, prisoners and cooking.
Cleaning is 50% faster.
Tending quality up 5% and immunity builds 10% faster.
Doctors and the wounded or ill like it and ascetics don't mind; most others dislike it, and the lazy hate it.

plain.li: About time. The hospital floor was a disgrace.
[hurt] Half of us are bandaged and the beds haven't been aired in a week. Scrub the place.

cold.li: Fewer infections means fewer graves to dig.

plain.li: The kitchen floor will be spotless, and my knees will be ruined.

blunt.li: I've lived with dirt all my life. I'm fine.

cheerful.li: I'm making it a game. Whoever finds the most mud wins!

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: days of rest
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Three easier days. Everyone works 10% slower, and strain drains 75% faster. With "Answers play out on the map" on, the rest of the first day's working hours become free time for everyone but the industrious. Most colonists like it and the lazy love it; the industrious hate it and hard workers dislike it. Only with feelings and strain switched on.
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.heartCost: everyone works 10% slower for three days

effects.li: Everyone works 10% slower.
Strain drains 75% faster while it lasts.
Most colonists like it and the lazy love it; the industrious hate it and hard workers dislike it.

plain.li: Three days. That's all I'm asking for. Three days with my boots off.
My hands shake by the end of the day now. Three short days would put that right.
Everyone's tired, and it shows in the work. Give us the days.

warm.li: Look at us. Half of us are asleep on our feet. Let's stop for a few days.
Long evenings together would do us more good than any amount of work.

gloomy.li: If we don't rest now, we'll be resting in the graveyard.
I don't remember the last time I slept enough.

cold.li: Tired hands make mistakes. A short rest costs less than a long recovery.

plain.li: The fields won't tend themselves while we nap.
Short days now means long days later. The work doesn't go anywhere.
I can't rest anyway. I just lie there and think.

blunt.li: Three slow days means three days' work waiting after.

cheerful.li: Rest? I've been looking forward to finishing the north wall!
I'll rest when I'm old! Hand me something to do.
